text:
Situation: Baclofen 20 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 199 tablets at 5.8 per day for 34.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 198 tablets at 8.3 per day for 23.9 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 54 tablets at 1.9 per day for 28.1 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the plant. FDA inspected Bryant Ranch Prepack and classified it VAI on 2026-07-16. FDA's drug shortage list does not include baclofen as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides 23.9 to 34.2 days of supply across sites. The VAI classification at Bryant Ranch Prepack warrants verification of supply reliability before relying on that source. Advagen Pharma Limited is the top-ranked buying option and is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no plant we could place. Availability must be confirmed before ordering.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify current supply reliability with Bryant Ranch Prepack given the 2026-07-16 VAI classification. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to confirm Advagen Pharma Limited product availability and lead time. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. If Advagen Pharma Limited is unavailable, buyer to evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK, Chartwell RX LLC, and Eywa Pharma Inc in ranked order. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Buyer to place purchase order for the first confirmed available source. Approval: Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee Chair.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative products or changing clinical protocols without P&T Committee review.
